public_payload.normalized_proposition: For OpenAI to go public, it will need revenue and loss numbers competitive with Anthropic, which has significantly faster growth and a larger enterprise customer base.

statement.excerpt: For OpenAI to go public, it will need to have numbers that are competitive — both in revenues and losses — with Anthropic, a company with significantly-faster growth and a larger enterprise customer base.

from_speaker: significantly-faster growth and a larger enterprise customer base
our_interpretation: The main assertion is a necessary condition for a completed OpenAI IPO. Confidential filing or preparations do not satisfy that condition.
Read 'competitive' as broadly comparable financial performance capable of attracting public investors; the speaker gives no numerical cutoff.
Compare revenues and losses for matching reporting periods and accounting definitions at the IPO.
The growth and enterprise-customer comparison describes the publication-time background. It cannot establish the future IPO requirement.
No accounting basis is identified for the comparison, so the contract records it as unknown.
criteria.support_condition: A completed IPO with comparable financial disclosures and direct evidence that competitive revenue and loss figures were necessary for the offering. The publication-time growth and customer assertions also require matched evidence.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI completes an IPO despite clearly noncompetitive revenue or loss figures against Anthropic on comparable measures. An IPO with competitive figures alone does not establish necessity.
